items.q: Red Saunders. He was a father confessor and out of that you had one of the greatest drummers that ever lived in the jazz world, Ike Day.

ctx.x: Red Saunders. He was a father confessor and out of that you had one of the greatest drummers that ever lived in the jazz world, Ike Day. Nobody has ever and ever will play that much drums. No, they won't play as much as him.
He got wasted along the way, didn't he?
